CONTEXT.content: Effective AI prompts include constraints: output format, forbidden actions, verification steps, and scope boundaries.
CONTEXT.analogy: Guardrails on a highway — they don't drive for you, but they stop catastrophic departures.
CONTEXT.productionNote: Unbounded AI tasks in CI or codegen pipelines are incident factories.
hints: What should the AI never do?

DECIDE.optionA: Single detailed prompt with all constraints inline.

tradeoffs.A: Portable; hard to maintain as rules grow.
tradeoffs.B: Reusable rules; requires discipline to keep in sync.

hints: Which constraints apply to every task vs this task only?

BUILD.goal: Write a reusable prompt template for your stack with: role, constraints, output format, and self-check steps.

tracks.general: Template for 'implement feature X in my app' tasks.

acceptance: Explicit forbidden actions (e.g., no secrets, no deleting tests)
Required output format (files changed, test commands run)
Self-check questions AI must answer before finishing
hints: Require running tests, not assuming they pass.

criteria: Template prevents at least one bad behavior you saw before
Output format is parseable by you or CI
Self-check catches an intentional bad suggestion in a test run
hints: Red-team your own template with a malicious task.

BREAK.scenario: AI follows template but invents a dependency that doesn't exist.
BREAK.symptoms: package.json updated with fake package. Build fails in CI.

FIX.goal: Add guardrail: verify packages exist before adding. Add CI check for lockfile consistency.
hints: Template is living document — update after incidents.

decisionCallbacks.A: Inline constraints were complete but duplicated across every prompt.
decisionCallbacks.B: Separated system prompt made updates easier when the fake-package incident revealed a gap.
